{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"Payments sat under an engineering manager, the guy who originally bought us, and he left last year.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep (Elena, account executive)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Original buyer left, leaving payments without an owner before evaluation."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"Stefan came from a much bigger company, and the first thing he did was pull declines by country.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep (Elena, account executive)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Stefan's first action was a country-level decline analysis."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"A few of their international markets looked bad to him.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Stefan (head of payments, customer), relayed by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Stefan's judgment of international performance, relayed without quotes."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"He mentioned Brazil and a couple in Europe.","label":"fact","speaker":"Stefan (head of payments, customer), relayed by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Named markets are vague; rep cannot name the European ones."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"I never saw his analysis.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep (Elena, account executive)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep has no direct view of the decline analysis."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"Stefan recommended it and the CFO approved.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep (Elena, account executive)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Decider claim is secondhand from Stefan; CFO never named."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"this went to the CFO two weeks ago.","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan (head of payments, customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Stefan says CFO sign-off came two weeks before the rep's last call."},
{"id":"E9","turn":8,"excerpt":"Yeah.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep (Elena, account executive)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep confirms the two-week timing without a calendar date."},
{"id":"E10","turn":10,"excerpt":"Adyen ran a test on a slice of their international traffic and came back with results by country.","label":"fact","speaker":"Stefan (head of payments, customer), relayed by rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Adyen test reported secondhand; no test content seen by us."},
{"id":"E11","turn":10,"excerpt":"local acquiring","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan (head of payments, customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","language"],"note":"Stefan's repeated phrase, the core of the competitive message."},
{"id":"E12","turn":10,"excerpt":"I can't tell you what the test showed. He wouldn't share it.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep (Elena, account executive)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Test results withheld; we do not know what won Stefan over."},
{"id":"E13","turn":12,"excerpt":"They got very specific. What's our approval rate in this country, on this card type, by issuer. {"id":"E15","turn":14,"excerpt":"The average uplift customers see.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep (Elena, account executive)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Our pitch centered on average uplift, which the customer rejected."},
{"id":"E16","turn":14,"excerpt":"that's an average. What's mine?","label":"quote","speaker":"Stefan (head of payments, customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language","gaps"],"note":"Direct rejection of averages; he wants his own numbers."},

{"id":"E18","turn":16,"excerpt":"The developers love us, billing works, nobody wanted to rip anything out.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep (Elena, account executive)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep's read of why the account stayed; not evidence of intent."},
{"id":"E19","turn":16,"excerpt":"That's why the US stayed.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep (Elena, account executive)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Only the US is confirmed retained; the rest of the business is unclear."},
{"id":"E20","turn":16,"excerpt":"Silence was the uplift number, like I said.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep (Elena, account executive)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep's read: the uplift figure drew no customer reaction."},
{"id":"E21","turn":16,"excerpt":"I offered a roadmap session and he didn't take it.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep (Elena, account executive)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Roadmap offer declined, a sign of low engagement."},

{"id":"E23","turn":18,"excerpt":"It was kind of decided before we got in the room.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep (Elena, account executive)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's theory; conflicts with an active evaluation still running."},
{"id":"E24","turn":18,"excerpt":"I'm not sure there was anything to do.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep (Elena, account executive)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's fatalism; no pre-decision effort is described."},

{"id":"E26","turn":22,"excerpt":"It was a healthy account. Growing, no tickets.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep (Elena, account executive)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep's view of account health before the evaluation began."},
